description_ru: В лондонском аэропорту медсестра берёт чужой чемодан и находит в нём удивительные подарки.
text:
Maria is a nurse from Italy, and today she is flying to London for a holiday. She is tired and happy. At the airport in London, she waits near the belt for her suitcase. Many bags go round and round. At last she sees a black suitcase with a yellow ribbon on the handle. "That is mine," she thinks. She takes it and walks to the taxi.

At the hotel, Maria goes to her room and puts the suitcase on the bed. She opens it and stops. There are no clothes inside. There are no shoes and no books. She sees a lot of small boxes, and every box has a name on it. Her face goes pale. "This is not my suitcase," she says aloud. "I take the wrong one!"

Maria looks at the boxes more closely. Each one has a name and an address in London. On top, there is a letter. It says, "To Mr. John Baker, with love from your daughter." Maria opens another box by accident. Inside, there is a pretty scarf. In another one, she finds a book of poems. They are all presents! She sits down on the bed. Somewhere, a man is crying for his lost bag.

Maria does not know what to do. She calls the airport, but the line is busy. She waits an hour. She calls again, and a woman says, "Please come to the lost bags office tomorrow morning." Maria is worried. She does not sleep well that night. In her dreams, she sees small boxes flying around the room.

The next morning, before she goes out, Maria makes a list of things she needs. She has no clean clothes, no toothbrush and no shampoo. She walks to a small shop near the hotel and buys a few things. A kind woman at the shop asks, "Are you on holiday?" Maria says yes. She does not tell her about the strange suitcase. It feels like a secret.

At eight o'clock, she is already at the office. A young man with a sad face is standing at the desk. He is shouting, "My suitcase! It has Christmas presents for my family!" Maria looks at the yellow ribbon in her hand. She walks to him slowly. "Excuse me," she says. "Is your name Mr. Baker?" The man turns. "Yes! How do you know?" She shows him the letter and smiles. "I think I have your suitcase."

Mr. Baker cannot believe it. He jumps up and almost hugs her. "Thank you, thank you!" he says. "These presents are for my children. I live in Canada, and I only see them once a year. I make every present with my own hands." Maria is surprised. She opens the box with the scarf again and sees small stitches. "You make these?" she asks. "Yes," he says, "I am a tailor. My wife is gone, and the children are my whole life."

Now Maria asks the woman at the desk about her own suitcase. It is there, in a corner! Another person with a black bag and a yellow ribbon is waiting for it. Mr. Baker laughs. "Ah, I think the ribbon is my daughter's idea. She puts the same ribbon on every bag!" Maria laughs too. Two strangers with the same bag are a funny sight.

Before she leaves, Maria goes to see the office woman again. "Thank you for your help," she says. The woman smiles. "It is a happy end," she says. "Usually, nobody finds a lost bag so fast. And usually, the people are not so kind." Maria takes her own suitcase and checks it at once. Everything is inside, even her favourite book. She feels very glad.

Mr. Baker invites her for coffee. They talk for two hours about Italy, Canada and nurses and tailors. Before they say goodbye, he gives Maria a small box from his suitcase. Inside there is a soft blue scarf. "For the kind woman who finds my bag," he says. Maria wears it all week in London. Every time somebody says, "What a lovely scarf!" she tells the story and smiles. She often thinks about Mr. Baker and his children, far away in Canada. At home in Italy, she sends him a card in December. A month later, a small parcel arrives at her door. Inside there is a white hat, and a note says, "Happy new year from the tailor with the yellow ribbon."

focus_sounds.tip_ru: Двигайте язык от «э» к «и»; не произносите как чистое «э» или «эй» с резким «й».
Долгий звук между «э» и «ё», губы не округляйте; в американском варианте добавляется «r».
Округлите губы, как для «у», и резко раскройте; нижняя губа не касается зубов.
Лёгкий выдох из горла без трения; не произносите как русское «х».

questions.question: What does Maria find in the suitcase?
questions.answer: Small boxes with presents and names.

questions.question: Who owns the suitcase?
questions.answer: Mr. Baker, a tailor from Canada.
